Context: 10. Retention of Accommodation

- GIO (10), Rule 40.  
Retention of accommodation on death, retirement and transfer of an allottee posted to a non-family station and re-transfer to any place (1) In the event of retirement or transfer of an allottee during his posting to a non-family station, the allottee shall be allowed the facility of retention of accommodation under occupation at the last place of posting prior to transfer to a non-family station for the period permissible
